mines.mine_notes: Flagship gold-silver project in Durango State, Mexico; one of the largest undeveloped gold-silver deposits in the Americas. Development stage: advancing a PFS in 2026 based on proprietary sulphide heap oxidation/leach technology for Phase 1. 2023 Amended PEA (eff. Dec 15, 2022) superseded earlier milling studies. Updated MRE (2021/2022 drilling, pit shell, 0.26 g/t AuEq cutoff): M+I 921.2 Mt @ 0.57 g/t Au, 14.3 g/t Ag = 16.77 Moz Au, 423.2 Moz Ag; Inferred 139.5 Mt @ 0.47 g/t Au, 13.2 g/t Ag = 2.13 Moz Au, 59.0 Moz Ag. Earlier 2016 updated PFS (milling route) reported P&P reserves of 1,102.3 Mt @ 0.764 g/t AuEq, 0.516 g/t Au, 14.2 g/t Ag, 0.164% Zn = 18.28 Moz Au, 501.6 Moz Ag, 4.0 Blb Zn (no longer the development basis). Also holds the Lucy exploration project and the Talapoosa project (Nevada).

notes: Ticker CKG on TSX-V; OTCQX: CHPGF. No production, no revenue. FY2025 net loss C$4.58M ($0.07/share). Cash of C$10.65M at Dec 31, 2025; total assets C$167.8M. Exploration/evaluation assets C$153.7M. President: P. Randy Reifel; Interim CEO: Jean-Paul Tsotsos (Sept 2025 update). Eric Sprott (2176423 Ontario Ltd.) is a sole investor in a financing. Recovering the San Vicente 3 concession is a precondition for the optimal PFS.
